Each side of triangle RST is 19 times the length of the corresponding side of triangle XYZ. What is the measure, in degrees, of one of the angles in triangle RST?

18.text: In the given equation, c and k are constants. The equation has exactly one solution. Which of the following statements must be true?

choices.A: The value of c cannot be −5.
choices.B: The value of c cannot be −5/2.
choices.C: The value of k cannot be 2/5.
choices.D: The value of k cannot be −2.
